slab-error-partial: Only a whole slab fits here
handbook-slab-slicing-text: Hold right-click on it with a knife to slice off one piece of meat, or right-click with a cleaver to chop one off at once. Only whole slabs go on a smoke rack or hook, or into a pot roast.
blockdesc-roastingdish-*-raw: Fire it in a pit kiln to use it.
blockdesc-roastingdishlid-*-raw: Fire it in a pit kiln to use it.
blockdesc-roastingdishlid-*-fired: Right-click a finished dish in a roasting dish to cover it and make it last longer!
lid-error-cannotcover: Only a finished dish in a roasting dish can be covered
blockdesc-roastingdish-*-fired: Set it on a lit firepit, with tongs in your off-hand, to cook a Pot Roast or Braised Meat. See their handbook pages for each step.
roast-error-raw: Bake it in a clay oven before serving
roast-needs-liquid: Add a braising liquid (water, milk, honey, or alcohol) before baking
roast-needs-side: Add at least one side before baking
roast-error-notliquid: This can't be used as braising liquid (use water, milk, honey, or alcohol)
blockhelp-roast-addtopping: Garnish with salt or a herb (optional)
roast-error-toppingfull: The roast already has its topping
roast-error-toppingraw: Garnish the pot roast once it is baked
game:handbook-mealrecipe-directionstext-:
1. Clay-form a roasting dish and fire it in a pit kiln.
2. rightmouse-click a lit firepit with the dish to set it on the fire. Hold tongs in your off-hand to work the dish.
3. Add a piece of animal fat and let it render, or add rendered fat, lard or cooking oil. Optionally stir in one flour for a roux until it toasts golden and then brown.
4. Add a whole meat slab, raw or smoked, and let it sear.
5. Add one to three sides, 2 vegetables or fruit each, and let them soften.
6. Pour in a braising liquid (water, milk, honey, broth (EF), or alcohol) from a bucket or jug. It reduces in the oven.
7. Take the roast off with an empty hand and bake it in a preheated clay oven.
8. Place the baked roast. Optionally garnish it with salt or a herb, then rightmouse-click it with an empty bowl to serve a portion. Each roast serves 6.
blockhelp-firepit-dish: Put the roasting dish on the fire
braise-roast-ready: Ready for the oven: take it off the fire
braise-error-slabalone: A meat slab goes in on its own, before anything else
blockhelp-braise-addslab: Add a whole meat slab to prepare a pot roast (tongs in off-hand)
blockhelp-braise-addside: Add a side, 2 of a vegetable (tongs in off-hand)
blockhelp-braise-roastready: Take the pot roast off for the oven
braise-error-hasroux: There is already a roux in the dish
braise-error-rouxfirst: Flour goes in before the meat
blockhelp-braise-addroux: Stir in flour for a roux, optional (tongs in off-hand)
braise-error-needfat: Start with fat, lard or cooking oil
braise-error-hasfat: There is already fat in the dish
braise-error-notingredient: That can't go in yet (try meat, fish fillet, sausage, tofu, 3 mushrooms or 2 eggs)
braise-error-toppingfull: One topping per piece of meat
braise-error-toppingnotdone: Toppings go on once the dish is done
blockhelp-braise-addtopping: Garnish the finished dish: salt or a herb, optional (tongs in off-hand)
blockhelp-braise-addliquid: Pour in a braising liquid from a bucket or jug (tongs in off-hand)
blockhelp-braise-takeoff: Take the dish off (tongs in off-hand)
braise-error-meatfirst: Meat goes in before the vegetables and liquid
braise-error-vegbeforeliquid: Vegetables go in before the liquid
braise-error-eggroux: Eggs don't go into a roux
braise-error-eggsalone: Eggs are cooked on their own
braise-error-eggsset: Too late, the eggs have set
braise-error-eggliquid: Only a splash of milk goes into eggs
braise-error-eggside: That doesn't go with eggs (try vegetables, fruit, mushrooms or meat)
braise-error-milkscramble: Scramble the eggs first, then add milk
blockhelp-braise-addmilk: Pour in a splash of milk (optional)
blockhelp-braise-addeggside: Add a side: vegetables, fruit, mushrooms or meat (optional)
game:handbook-mealrecipe-directionstext-:
1. Clay-form a roasting dish and fire it in a pit kiln.
2. rightmouse-click a lit firepit with the dish to set it on the fire. Hold tongs in your off-hand to work the dish.
3. Add a piece of animal fat and let it render, or add rendered fat, lard or cooking oil.
4. Crack in 2 eggs at a time, up to 4.
5. Optionally add up to 2 sides: carrot, parsnip or turnip coins, onion, garlic or leek petals, or strips of meat or fish.
6. Let them cook until the whites and yolks set, then optionally garnish with salt or a herb.
7. Take the dish off with an empty hand, set it down and serve one bowl per 2 eggs.

1. Clay-form a roasting dish and fire it in a pit kiln.
2. rightmouse-click a lit firepit with the dish to set it on the fire. Hold tongs in your off-hand to work the dish.
3. Add a piece of animal fat and let it render, or add rendered fat, lard or cooking oil.
4. Crack in 2 eggs at a time, up to 4.
5. Before they set, rightmouse-click with a stick in your main hand to scramble them, then optionally pour in a splash of milk for a fuller, creamier scramble.
6. Optionally add up to 3 sides: root vegetable coins, onion petals, or strips of meat or fish.
7. Let it cook, then optionally garnish with salt or a herb.
8. Take the dish off with an empty hand, set it down and serve one bowl per 2 eggs.

1. Clay-form a roasting dish and fire it in a pit kiln.
2. rightmouse-click a lit firepit with the dish to set it on the fire. Hold tongs in your off-hand to work the dish.
3. Add a piece of animal fat and let it render, or add rendered fat, lard or cooking oil. Optionally stir in one flour for a roux where it toasts golden and then brown.
4. Add one or two pieces of red meat, bushmeat, poultry or fish fillet (raw or smoked for all), tofu, or 3 mushrooms of any kind, and let them brown. Mushrooms added after that go in as vegetables.
5. Add vegetables, fruit or mushrooms one at a time, up to 3 per piece of meat, and let them soften.
6. Pour in 1 L of braising liquid (water, milk, honey, broth (EF), or alcohol) from a bucket or jug and let it reduce.
7. Once it is done, optionally garnish each piece of meat with salt or a herb.
8. Take the dish off with an empty hand, set it down and serve one bowl per piece of meat.
